_what: COOK TWO [the street joins for the map] (10/18): the pieces that join one district's street to the next, cut from his tiles on the map's own 96 m cell lines; a SEAM piece straddles a cell line (12 m each side), a CELL piece is one whole map cell. RUN lays them where the map has that join; COOK TWO owns the pixels.
scale_note: his native 57 px a metre reduced 4 to 1; the map's near stop is 2.67 px a metre, so RUN reduces
map_widths_note: real widths: arterial 14 m, local 11 m, freeway 25 m, ramp 5 m; the map's BW table draws arterial 9 m, freeway 12 m: RUN matches the piece to the road, or the road to the piece
